description: This source file defines Swagger API response/request schemas for FinancialActivityAccounts API endpoints in a Fineract accounting module. It contains nested static classes annotated with Swagger Schema annotations describing various request and response objects related to financial activity account operations.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing request and response schemas for the FinancialActivityAccounts API endpoints.

classes.name: GetFinancialActivityAccountsResponse
classes.description: Represents the response schema for retrieving financial activity account details, including ID and associated data objects.

classes.name: PostFinancialActivityAccountsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new financial activity account with financial activity ID and GL account ID.

classes.name: PostFinancialActivityAccountsResponse
classes.description: Response schema indicating the resource ID of the created financial activity account.

classes.name: PutFinancialActivityAccountsRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing financial activity account with new financial activity and GL account IDs.

classes.name: PutFinancialActivityAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating an account, including resource ID and optional comments.

classes.name: PutFinancialActivityAccountscommentsSwagger
classes.description: Nested class within the put response schema representing comments related to the account update.

classes.name: DeleteFinancialActivityAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a financial activity account, mainly the resource ID.
